content.short: ĀutID is a self-sovereign NFT ID tied to its holders and their decentralized communities.
content.description: Identity systems, including Web3, frequently operate in isolation—relevant only within a single closed ecosystem with custom parameters or dependent on an external provider such as a passport or social account. ĀutID provides a relational, universal identity framework with built-in global reputation that holds both the holders and the communities they belong to accountable. ĀutIDs are pseudonymous, portable, non-transferable, and DAO-bound.
